_note: F11 comparability decisions. Source: USGS peak-file flag gage_ht_cd=6 ('Gage datum changed during this year'), read with `preflight.py peakcodes` on Oct 10 2026. Stage readings before a datum change are in a different datum and are not converted here (the shift size is unknown), so the stage record is truncated to start the water year AFTER the flagged year. peak_cd=C (urbanization/channelization) is set on nearly every row for every gauge, so it does not discriminate. The stage-discharge screen in preflight.py agreed for Brays and Greens (within a year) and disagreed elsewhere; USGS flags win. Discharge-based pricing over the longer record is the planned sensitivity for gauges with fewer than 20 comparable years.
